description: This source file implements the SetVolume class, which is responsible for setting the volume of a WebAudio player stream using GStreamer. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute methods, and interacts with external GStreamer functions and logging.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A class responsible for setting the volume of a WebAudio stream in the Rialto server.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetVolume object with context, GStreamer wrapper, and volume level.

methods.name: ~SetVolume
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the SetVolume object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the volume setting operation by calling the GStreamer wrapper to set the stream volume.
